description: Creates or updates Home Links for the project. Entries with an id update existing links; entries without an id create new ones. Request order becomes each link's position.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Home Link.

title.description: Display title of the Home Link.

url.description: Destination URL of the Home Link.

position.description: Sort order among project Home Links. Present when view is extended.

project_id.description: ID of the project that owns the link. Present when view is extended.

created_at.description: When the link was created. Present when view is extended.

id.description: Unique identifier of an existing Home Link to update. Omit to create.

title.description: Display title of the Home Link.

url.description: Destination URL of the Home Link.
